newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ADNOC to close 135,000-bpd CDU mid Nov-traders.
newsitem.headline: ADNOC to close 135,000-bpd CDU mid Nov-traders.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Co (ADNOC) has scheduled a three-week maintenance shutdown for its Ruwais 135,000-bpd crude distillation unit (CDU) in mid-November, traders said on Friday.
ADNOC officials could not be contacted to confirmed the shutdown.
The shutdown will be the third in the Gulf during November, traders said.
The 305,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) Jubail refinery in Saudi Arabia is due for maintenance in November for about one month.
Jubail is operated by Saudi Aramco Shell Refinery Co (Sasref), a joint venture between state-owned Aramco and Royal Dutch Shell Group
Also a 170,000-bpd CDU at Kuwait's Mina al-Ahmadi 420,000-bpd refinery will be shutdown on November 3 for three weeks of maintenance, traders said.
